name: agent_decompile
description: MCP Agent wrapper for JADX APK/DEX decompiler CLI
author: MCP Agent Generator

tools.name: decompile_apk
tools.description: Decompile an APK file to Java source code

apk_path.description: Path to the APK file to decompile

output_dir.description: Output directory for decompiled sources (default: temp dir)

tools.name: decompile_dex
tools.description: Decompile a DEX file to Java source code

dex_path.description: Path to the DEX file to decompile

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search for a keyword in previously decompiled sources

keyword.description: Keyword or regex pattern to search for

search_dir.description: Directory containing decompiled sources to search in

protocol.description: Calls jadx CLI via subprocess, 10-minute timeout for APK decompilation
